name: Bishoujo ga Kuru! ~Yarareru Mae ni Yatte Yaru~
original_name: 美少女が来る！～ヤられる前にヤってやる～
source:
One day, a pretty girl suddenly appears in front of Toru. Her name is Iori from another world. She chops at him with a sword! He doesn't know what's going on, but he somehow runs away from her.... On the next day, Iori appears as a transfer student and moves into a room next to him. She also persistently tells him to become her boyfriend.... Will she just try to kill him? He tries to escape, but she runs after him. Well, will he be able to run away from her...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090107032007/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010454]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
一天，一名美少女突然出现在彻面前。她名叫伊织，来自另一个世界，一见面便挥剑砍向他！彻完全不明白发生了什么，只能设法逃走…第二天，伊织以转学生身份出现，还搬进了他隔壁的房间。她又执拗地要求彻成为自己的男朋友…她难道只是想杀掉他吗？彻试图逃走，她却紧追不舍。他究竟能不能从伊织手中逃脱？
